profile.headline: AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate │ M.S. Cybersecurity │ CompTIA Sec+ │ Full-Stack Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I wrote my first line of code in college and haven't stopped since.
 
Since graduating in 2022, I've built backend systems for a metaverse platform, shipped API infrastructure for a Web3 minting app, worked on healthcare applications used by real patients, and co-founded a startup.
 
My stack is broad by design: MEAN, MERN, Django, FastAPI, Unity 3D, Raspberry Pi, Arduino, React Native, Next.js, ASP.NET, Node.js, MongoDB, AWS, Azure, Docker. I've worked in fast-moving startups and structured engineering teams. I'm comfortable being the only developer in the room and equally comfortable collaborating across a full team.
 
I completed my Master's in Cybersecurity in 2026 — not because I wanted to switch careers, but because I believe engineers who understand security write fundamentally better software.
 
Looking for my next full-time role in software engineering — full stack, backend, or anything at the intersection of engineering and security.
 
Open to a conversation? Hit connect or drop me a message.
